title: Furies
tagline: Furies: Added support for tenderly tx simulation in AgentKit
description: AgentKit now integrates Tenderly transaction simulation, allowing developers to simulate and preview transactions before execution. This enhancement provides Agents built on AgentKit with a reliable way to test and validate transactions in a risk-free environment, ensuring accurate execution and improved security. With Tenderly's powerful simulation engine, developers can analyze gas consumption, detect potential failures, and optimize smart contract interactions seamlessly.
how_its_made: We have added support for Tenderly transaction simulation as an action in AgentKit by integrating the Tenderly API directly into AgentKit's action framework. This allows developers to seamlessly simulate transactions before execution, enabling Agents built on AgentKit to test, validate, and optimize smart contract interactions in a risk-free environment. With this integration, users can analyze gas usage, detect potential failures, and ensure smooth execution, enhancing both security and efficiency in Web3 automation.
